evidence_sentence: The function checks if the provided iterator is valid and determines if a copy of the data is necessary based on alignment and mapping conditions.
rationale: The fixed implementation adds an explicit `iter_is_iovec(iter)` validation before performing mapping, whereas the vulnerable implementation has no iterator-validity/type check. The docstring explicitly claims that the function checks whether the iterator is valid, thereby describing the fixed-only guard. Its remaining statements about copy selection, iterative mapping, cleanup on mapping failure, and request flags are shared by both versions.
rewritten_docstring: The function determines if a copy of the data is necessary based on alignment and mapping conditions. It iterates over the I/O vectors, mapping them to the request using a helper function. If any mapping fails, it unmaps any previously mapped bio and returns an error. If successful, it sets the appropriate flags on the request.
